ai_summary: Archidply Decor Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Devesh Daga as an Additional Director (Executive Director), effective November 13, 2026, to oversee key functions including marketing, business development, and operations. A significant red flag is his familial relationship as the son of the current Managing Director and nephew of a Non-Executive Director, which raises concerns about potential nepotism and corporate governance. Additionally, the document shows a notable discrepancy with the letter dated November 13, 2024, informing of an appointment effective two years later in November 2026, which is unusually early or a potential typo.
